prompt.zh-TW: 小嵐和兩位朋友一共拿出 {{money:vars.capital}} 成立月光書店，錢已經存進公司帳戶。這筆出資在資產負債表上記在哪裡？
prompt.en: Lan and two friends put in {{money:vars.capital}} between them to set up Moonlight Books, and the money is now in the company account. Where is this contribution recorded on the balance sheet?

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。股東投入的錢是公司自己的資金來源，記在股東權益。
feedback.en: Nice work. Money put in by shareholders is the company’s own source of funds and sits in equity.

text.zh-TW: 流動負債，因為公司欠股東這筆錢
text.en: Current liabilities, because the company owes this money to its shareholders

feedback.zh-TW: 你知道這筆錢的來源是股東，這點沒錯。不過股東出資不是借款：公司沒有約定要在某天還給股東，股東拿到的是公司的所有權，所以放股東權益而不是負債。
feedback.en: You know the money came from the shareholders, which is right. But a contribution is not a loan: the company has not promised to repay it on any date, and what the shareholders receive is ownership of the company, so it sits in equity rather than liabilities.

text.zh-TW: 資產，因為錢已經進了公司帳戶
text.en: Assets, because the money is already in the company account

feedback.zh-TW: 帳戶裡的錢確實是資產，這點沒錯。不過那是「現金」這個科目；題目問的是這筆錢「從哪裡來」，來源要記在右邊的股本。一筆出資會同時讓現金和股本增加。
feedback.en: The money in the account is indeed an asset, that much is right. But that is the cash account; the question asks where the money came from, and the source is recorded on the right as share capital. A contribution raises cash and share capital at the same time.

explanation.zh-TW: 資產負債表的右邊分成兩種錢的來源：要還的是負債，不用還、屬於股東的是{{term:tm_x3n8v5tc}}。股東出資記在{{term:tm_5e3py55a}}，所以是{{option:o_a0pb}}；{{option:o_tjjy}}把它當成借款，{{option:o_rxmj}}則只看到左邊的現金。
explanation.en: The right side of the balance sheet shows two kinds of source: money that has to be repaid is a liability, and money that belongs to the shareholders with nothing to repay is {{term:tm_x3n8v5tc}}. Shareholder contributions are recorded as {{term:tm_5e3py55a}}, so {{option:o_a0pb}} is right; {{option:o_tjjy}} treats it as a loan, and {{option:o_rxmj}} only sees the cash on the left.
